# Method: endShape()

```ts
endShape(close?): void;
```

Finish the active custom shape and enqueue its geometry.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `close?` | `"close"` | Pass `'close'` to connect the final vertex back to the first for line-strip shapes. |

## Returns

`void`
